question_cn: 2026 世界杯 H 组头名（FIFA 最终积分榜第 1）会是哪支球队？（西班牙 / 乌拉圭 / 沙特阿拉伯 / 佛得角）
question_en: Which team will win Group H (first place in the final FIFA standings) at the 2026 World Cup? (Spain / Uruguay / Saudi Arabia / Cape Verde)
one_liner_cn: 西班牙以 Elo 世界第一的实力大概率拿下 H 组头名（约 84%），乌拉圭是唯一现实的挑战者；沙特与佛得角夺组头名基本只是数学上的可能。
one_liner_en: Spain, the world's No. 1 Elo side, is the heavy model favorite to top Group H (~84%); Uruguay is the only realistic challenger, with Saudi Arabia and Cape Verde left as mathematical possibilities.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距悬殊：西班牙 2157（世界第 1）对乌拉圭 1892（第 16）、沙特 1576、佛得角 1578，10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟给出西班牙 86.2% 的头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Massive Elo gap: Spain 2157 (world No. 1) vs Uruguay 1892 (No. 16), Saudi Arabia 1576 and Cape Verde 1578; the 100k-run pure-Elo Monte Carlo gives Spain an 86.2% baseline to top the group.

key_reasons.cn: 西班牙带伤进入小组赛：亚马尔腿筋伤可能缺席前 1-2 场、费尔明·洛佩斯骨折退出，构成小幅下调（−2pp）的依据，但主帅称首战基本全员可用。
key_reasons.en: Spain enter the group stage with knocks: Lamine Yamal's hamstring may cost the first one or two games and Fermin Lopez is out with a fracture, grounds for a small -2pp adjustment, though the coach expects near-full availability from game one.

key_reasons.cn: 乌拉圭是唯一现实挑战者但状态不佳：热身近 4 场不胜（含 1-5 负美国），夺头名几乎必须 6/27 直接击败西班牙，因此上调幅度有限（+1.8pp）。
key_reasons.en: Uruguay are the only realistic challenger but in poor form: winless in their last four (including 1-5 vs USA), and topping the group all but requires beating Spain on Jun 27, so the upward adjustment is capped (+1.8pp).

method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo, 100,000 full-tournament simulations (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input), group ranking by points/GD/goals/head-to-head/random; plus bounded evidence-based adjustment capped at +/-4pp per team (Spain -2.0pp injury risk, Uruguay +1.8pp, Saudi Arabia/Cape Verde +0.1pp each), renormalized to sum 1.
